SECRET.

Your Ref: P.47467/1.
Our Ref: PF.66074/F3m.

12th September 1945.

Dear Governor,

I return the two letters to OLDAG, which you were kind enough to let me see. As far as we are concerned they can now be given to the prisoner.

Yours sincerely,

G.R. Mitchell.

The Governor,
H.M. Prison,
BRIXTON.

Copies of letters p.a.d in:-

LEAN (PF.217,740)
DEAS. (PF.221,722)
